svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print a body 58 x 36 x 12 with a 3 mm flange 66 x 44 at its top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Key post 7 x 7, 16 tall, at the back right corner of the top face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pin holes through, matched to the plug: power 15 each side,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 13 in from the front of the body; signal at 7 pitch, 27 in.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Press in the pins: power pins 10 above the face (PACK- 11),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: signal pins 8, the INTERLOCK pin only 5, so it mates last.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Solder the 10 kOhm coding resistor from INTERLOCK to SGND.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: drops into the cavity from below; the flange stops under

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the pocket ledge with 3 mm to float each way; the foam pad

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and retainer plate hold it up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: it moves 3 mm each way by hand and springs back up.
